description: This file contains functions and types related to AI course structure generation, fine-tune data storage, stream reading utilities, question generation, and chat transport setup with fetch handling, specific to an AI learning platform.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Represents a question with options for AI course quizzes.

classes.name: SubTopic
classes.description: Represents a subtopic in the AI course roadmap.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Represents a topic in the AI course roadmap, possibly with children subtopics.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a label in the course roadmap.

classes.name: Title
classes.description: Represents a title in the course roadmap.

classes.name: ResultItem
classes.description: Union type for items in the course roadmap, including titles, topics, and labels.

classes.name: ChatUIMessage
classes.description: Type for chat messages with redirect info, based on UIMessage.

methods.name: generateAiCourseStructure
methods.description: Parses a string to generate an AiCourse object with title, modules, and lessons.

methods.name: storeFineTuneData
methods.description: Stores fine-tune metadata in localStorage and returns a session ID.

methods.name: getCourseFineTuneData
methods.description: Retrieves fine-tune metadata from localStorage by session ID.

methods.name: getLastSessionId
methods.description: Gets the last session ID stored in localStorage.

methods.name: clearFineTuneData
methods.description: Removes fine-tune data and last session ID from localStorage.

methods.name: readAIRoadmapStream
methods.description: Reads a stream of Uint8Array data, decodes it, and calls callbacks on new lines.

methods.name: readAIRoadmapContentStream
methods.description: Reads a stream of Uint8Array data, decodes it, and calls callbacks with accumulated content.

methods.name: readStream
methods.description: Generic stream reader that processes data and calls callbacks with partial and final results.

methods.name: generateAiCourseLessonQuestions
methods.description: Parses question data string into an array of Question objects with options.

methods.name: generateAICourseRoadmapStructure
methods.description: Parses a string into a structured array of ResultItems representing course roadmap.

methods.name: fetchWithAuthHandling
methods.description: Fetch wrapper that handles 401 errors, token removal, and error reporting.
